nome_en: Romanov the 1st GS, Lord of the Demonic Eye
testo:
Guard Strike
Double Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, you may put the top 5 cards of your deck into your graveyard. You may then cast a darkness spell that costs 6 or less from your graveyard for no cost. After you cast that spell, put it on the bottom of your deck instead of your graveyard.
testo_jp:
Guard Strike
Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが攻撃する時、自分の山札の上から5枚を墓地に置いてもよい。その後、闇のコスト6以下の呪文を1枚、自分の墓地からコストを支払わずに唱えてもよい。その呪文を唱えた後、墓地にかわりに山札の下に置く。
